name: tomame-native
description: Tomame for iPhone: a Capacitor shell that loads the mobile app (/m) from the Tomame web app. Installed with Xcode.

scripts.sim: node configure.mjs http://localhost:3010/m && cap sync ios
scripts.dev: node configure.mjs https://dev.tomame.ca/m && cap sync ios
scripts.prod: node configure.mjs https://tomame.ca/m && cap sync ios
